lines: Buffalo is 2-0 after 41-31 over Detroit on Thursday. Goff threw 26/38, 327 yards, 4 TD in a loss, which tells you how the Bills defence played.
Baltimore hosts New Orleans at BAL -8.5, total 46.5. Derrick Henry had 24 carries, 144 yards, 3 TD in the 41-23 win at Indy.
Pittsburgh is at New England and is the underdog at NE -5.5 despite being 1-0 after beating Atlanta 20-13.
Cleveland is 0-1 with a -24 differential after 34-10 at Jacksonville, and now goes to Tampa as an 8.5-point dog.
Chicago hosts Minnesota at CHI -4.5 after putting 59 on Carolina. Both teams are 1-0.
Miami at San Francisco is the week's biggest line, SF -13.5, after the Niners beat the Rams 27-7 in Melbourne.

pregame.matchup_read: Bengals go to Reliant Stadium as 1-0 road dogs, HOU -2.5, total 45.5, 1:00 am Monday Perth on CBS. Houston is 0-1 after losing 36-31 to Buffalo. Warm one, intermittent clouds, 32C.
storylines: Burrow was a full participant Friday after back tightness and is set to start, per ESPN. He called it ridiculous that a tight back would keep him out.
Texans ruled out Nico Collins with a hamstring injury, so Houston is short its top receiver.
Will Anderson called the 36-point Week 1 loss to Buffalo a wake-up call for the Houston defense ahead of this visit.
Bengals sit 1-0 with a +6 differential, behind Baltimore (+18) and Pittsburgh (+7) in the North on tiebreak noise.
watch_for: Burrow's mobility. He ran 5 times for 20 yards against Tampa, so watch whether the back lets him move off script.
Mike Gesicki after 5 rec, 78 yds, 1 TD in Week 1. Houston without Collins may play more middle-field coverage.
Cincinnati's run game. 27 carries for 106 yards, 3.9 per attempt, is thin for a game in the 90s.
pregame.the_call: Take the Bengals plus the 2.5 and I'd put them outright. Cincinnati won the turnover battle 4-1 last week and Houston is playing without Collins.

postgame.what_decided_it: Turnovers. Tampa lost four fumbles and Cincinnati scored a defensive touchdown. The Bengals also won the possession battle 31:25 to 28:35 and went 8-14 on third down.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 25/35, 254 yds, 1 TD, 1 INT. Efficient, not spectacular, 6.8 yards per pass.
Mike Gesicki: 5 rec, 78 yds, 1 TD. Team high in receiving.
Chase Brown: 16 car, 56 yds, 1 TD in a 106-yard rushing day.
postgame.division_meaning: Three-way tie at the top. Baltimore 1-0 at +18, Cincinnati 1-0 at +6, Pittsburgh 1-0 at +7. Cleveland is 0-1 at -24 after losing 34-10 at Jacksonville.
postgame.the_take: Four forced fumbles is not a repeatable plan. Cincinnati only out-gained Tampa 351 to 282 and went 2-5 in the red zone. Clean that up or Houston is a problem.
